content:
alex_cs: Quick sync — staging bring-up for dedicated capacity (acct-43). Need a short smoke run today so we can hand off tomorrow. Goals: validate autoscale policy, run 15m loadtest targeting 600->1k rps, check p95 latency and OOMs. Who can take autoscale + loadtest?

maria_infra: I can apply the autoscale policy and reserve quota. Will push config to staging now.

maria_infra: autoscale config I'm going to use: ```
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 8
(target_cpu_percent: 70)
burst_headroom: 2
reserved_slots: 4  # starting suggestion
```

sam_eng: I'll run the loadtest (k6). Need the staging endpoint + token. Also share the k6 script I'll use.

alex_cs: endpoint: `https://staging-infer.redwood.internal/v1/generate` 
curl example for smoke: ```
curl -X POST $ENDPOINT -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-tex-8b","input":"hello"}'
```

sam_eng: k6 script snippet I'll run: ```
import http from 'k6/http';
import {sleep} from 'k6';
export default function() {
  http.post('__ENDPOINT__', JSON.stringify({model:'rwd-tex-8b',input:'test'}), {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer __TOKEN__', 'Content-Type':'application/json'}})
  sleep(0.1);
}
```

jen_support: I'll prepare the runbook checklist and customer-facing notes. Will include the minimum SLA script for the enablement call.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: autoscale policy applied to cluster-staging-2 by maria_infra at 2025-11-09T14:12:03Z :white_check_mark:

sam_eng: Loadtest started 14:18 UTC — ramp 0 -> 600 rps over 3m, steady 15m. Sharing quick metrics in thread.

sam_eng: Results (15m steady at 600 rps): p50=48ms, p95=210ms, p99=520ms, errors=0, retries=3 (client-side). Throughput ~590 rps sustained.

maria_infra: Autoscale behavior: triggered at ~480 rps, scaled from 2 -> 4 replicas within 70s, CPU peaked at 83% on replicas, KV cache evictions=2 during spike. No OOMs.

alex_cs: Great. Quick analysis: performance looks acceptable for 600 rps but we need headroom for peaks. For renewal discussion (in 10 days) we should present a plan to sustain ~1k rps.

maria_infra: Recommendation: increase reserved_slots to 6 for production bring-up and set max_replicas=12. Also enable warmup cache TTL to 10m to reduce cold-starts.

sam_eng: If we push reserved_slots=6 and max_replicas=12, I can re-run a 30m test tomorrow to validate p95 target <250ms at 1k rps.

jen_support: I'll schedule the enablement call for tomorrow 11:00 PT and share the short checklist with the customer (what to expect during rollout).

pete_oncall: I'll keep an eye on staging logs and alerts for 48h. If we see retries >10% or any increased 5xx, I'll escalate.

alex_cs: Note on account health: AE flagged potential renewal risk if performance isn't stable before the review. Action items: 1) maria update autoscale config (today), 2) sam run 30m 1k rps test (tomorrow morning), 3) jen run enablement call (tomorrow 11am PT), 4) pete monitor 48h.

maria_infra: Applying updated config now: `reserved_slots=6, max_replicas=12, warmup_ttl=600` — will post when live.

maria_infra: Done — config live. Deploy id: deploy-77682.

sam_eng: Thanks — will run the 1k rps test at 10:00 PT tomorrow and post results.

jen_support: Sending calendar invites + runbook in #customer-success-docs, tagging the customer enablement doc.

alex_cs: Perfect. Also capture feedback from run — please paste any surprising logs or error patterns here. I'll summarize for AE before renewal call. :thumbsup:

sam_eng: Quick flag — saw increased tail latency on single replica while scale up kicked in; adding a 20s warmup step to k6 to let replicas initialize before ramping more aggressively.

maria_infra: Good call. I'll add a 30s probe to healthcheck to avoid cutting traffic prematurely during scale events.

alex_cs: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after sam posts the 1k run results. If anything blocks, ping @alex_cs directly.
